verdict.rationale: Cactus documents Whistle, an on-device speech-to-text model (a 16.9 MB file running on the CPU, seven languages). needle.stream(chunks) transcribes live for as long as the microphone runs, with word timestamps and keyword biasing. The engine also exposes OpenAI-compatible speech APIs, and a community user built a mic transcription project with Cactus. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Whistle's real-time streaming accuracy and latency.
